incident.name: keyv / cacheable maintainer-account compromise
incident.note: Fleet repositories are pinned to the last commit at or before as_of, the minute the first malicious version was published.

queries.q6:
// Q6: across the whole fleet, which direct dependency drags the affected versions in, and how many artifacts it covers.
// Bumping the top row removes the most exposure. Params: $advisory, $at_ms
MATCH (adv:Advisory {id: $advisory})-[r:AFFECTS]->(pv:PackageVersion)<-[:IS]-(bad:LockedDep)<-[:LOCKS]-(a:Artifact)-[:LOCKS]->(top:LockedDep {direct: true})
WHERE adv.published_ms <= $at_ms AND coalesce(r.since_ms, 0) <= $at_ms
WITH a, top, bad, shortestPath((top)-[:REQUIRES*0..8]->(bad)) AS p
WHERE p IS NOT NULL
RETURN top.name AS direct, top.version AS version, count(DISTINCT a) AS artifacts, collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS in_artifacts
ORDER BY artifacts DESC, direct
queries.q7:
// Q7: the packages an artifact leans on most, ranked by PageRank over the REQUIRES graph.
// A compromise of a high-ranked package reaches the most of the tree. Params: $prefix (artifact id plus ::), $limit
CALL algo.pageRank('LockedDep', 'REQUIRES') YIELD node, score
WHERE node.id STARTS WITH $prefix AND node.workspace IS NULL
RETURN node.name AS name, node.version AS version, score
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT $limit
